//: Download page contents. Edited by hand when you publish a release - the page renders
whatever is in here, so adding a version needs no code change and no redeploy of the app
Newest first: the first entry is presented as the current download and the rest as
'url' may be either an absolute URL (Supabase Storage, GitHub Releases, a CDN) or a path
relative to the site, in which case the file is served from wwwroot. Installers are large
and must not go into git; if you use the relative form, copy the file to
GMS.Web/wwwroot/releases/ on the server rather than committing it.
'sha256' is optional but worth filling in. It is what lets a customer confirm the file
they downloaded is the one you published:  Get-FileHash .\GMS-Setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
